notes.title: Demo Patch 0.5.0 - Improvements, Fixes and Additions
notes.content:
Hi everyone,  I have made some small improvements and fixes to the demo.    Improvements: 

Added and adjusted specializations (You can now have 2 specializations at once in the demo)

Added UI replication in the lobby (As non-host you can now see which settings are selected)

Updated the lobby and made it look nicer

Introduced other UX improvements

Updated the loading screen

  Fixes: 

Fixed some replication issues

Fixed an issue where names were not correctly displayed in the game

Fixed other various issues



And various other things have been improved.



I hope that you will continue to enjoy the demo alone or with your friends.  Thank you so much for trying out the demo and wishlisting the game. If you have feedback or ideas to share, please do not hesitate.  

Cheers,  

Mike

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1 - Improvements and Fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I have made some small improvements and fixes to the demo. 


Improvements:

 Added feedback when inviting players through the in-game friend list
 The HUD is now displayed during the level up process
 Removed exploding skeletons on wave 14
 Reduced enemy damage from 70% to 50% when playing on easy
 Improved Reflect passive description
 Rebalanced Suppressing Aura:
- Increased base starting damage from 10 to 15
- Decreased initial cooldown from 0.8s to 0.6s
- Changed starting attributes, now damages based on rarity instead of size increases
- Certain level ups now grant damage instead of cooldown
- Increased evolution life leach from 10% to 15%



Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where players would unlock the extreme difficulty
 Fixed an issue where the easy difficulty paid out higher rewards
 Fixed healing bubble healing amount as it was not healing as much as was displayed
 Fixed an issue where dark meteors were colliding an invisible wall


I hope that you will continue to enjoy the demo alone or with your friends. 
Thank you so much for trying out the demo and wishlisting the game. If you have feedback or ideas to share, please do not hesitate.

Kind regards,
Mike

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0 - New Map now available
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

After receiving tons of feedback regarding the map and the visual clarity, I have decided to swap out Undead Graveyard and use the Tower Top map for the demo which should be much much clearer for you players.

I will also update the trailer and screenshots in the coming week to then better represent the demo with the new map. 

Tower Top


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45031433/ef5b63308dc5222106115ae007cd85df4a5e98da.png


You try to survive on top of one of the towers which belong to the Necromancer 'Necros'.



Improvements:

 Added a toggle in the gameplay settings to turn on/off enemy outlines



Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where players were able to play on all difficulties from the beginning




I hope that you will continue to enjoy the demo alone or with your friends. I am eagerly checking the rankings and can see a lot of good players.
Thank you so much for trying out the demo and wishlisting the game. If you have feedback or ideas to share, please do not hesitate.

Kind regards,
Mike
